title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Working for a financial planning instituition 1492 views Q. I work in a Govt. Arms and Ammunition manufacturing unit under Ministry of Defence. A system called 'Outgoing Circular' is effective in our organisation in which a person or a group of people apply for outgoing facility for events like Diwali, Ganesh jayanti, Ambedkar jayanti, Ramdhan any many more events where they go out of the factory getting one time punching exemption and not to return for the day under the pretext of doing welfare work . In turn they get their Overtime booked for the whole day and get the pay accodingly. This type of facility is also availed by our muslim brethren in the holy month of Ramadhan. I want to ask whether taking this facility is jayaz as the overtime pay is granted if the person works in the factory beyond 8 hours of normal working. Please reply my query. May Allah give us all hidayat. 2663 views Q. The holy Hadith says you can keep dogs for guarding and hunting, but many people say not to keep dogs for even hunting or guarding, they say it is haram. Kindly clarify whether it is jaiaz or haram. 2305 views Q. Seeing Non-mahram 5851 views Q. Working on Cruise Ships & Missing Jumuah is haram or halal 4875 views Q. Assalamualaikum, I would like to ask if taking the services of companies like CRYOSAVE etc are BA SHARAH or not. They basically take umbilical cord blood(which is medical waste) just after the birth of babies and store it in their facility. the blood is a rich source of stem cells which can be used by the baby in case of any life threatening disease by implanting them to the affected part.The umbilical cord is the richest source of the best type of stem cells. Is it halaal to store it for a long period of time by freezing it? 2934 views Q. Halal or Haram 1730 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum! This is a great service and may Allah ta'ala grant us all his Qurb. I work for a company whose owner is a Muslim and a Hafil, Aalim. It is an internet search engine. My questions are: 1) Is it okay for us to employ non Muslim women for work? 2) Is the income from such ghair mahrams and non Muslims halal for us. 3) Can you provide us if possible only a list of non-shariah compliant businesses? 4) Regarding the inclusion of pictures of people and living things, please update us on the Islamic view in this matter. Jazakallahu kahairan, May Allah ta'ala make this a cause for our spiritual progress. Your earliest response is expected. 1780 views Q. We are involved in Pharmaceutical business where we work as Medicine manufacturer and Medical Representative. 3507 views Q. My wife shows desire in sucking parts of my body used for intercourse, is it permissible? Can I also do the same with her, specially in relation to her breasts? 40246 views Q. Mere 2 batche hai, do no bhi paidayeshi nabina (Blind)hai. Doctoro ka kehena hai ke ayenda hone vale batche bhi nabina paida hosakte hai, Hamare gharvale chahtehai ke Batche ki paidaish rook ne ke liye operation karvale, lakin ye haram hai, is wakth mai kya karsaktahu. Koi doosra raasta hai? 2312 views Q. Is sperm donation allowed in Islam? 11066 views Q. I am a software engineer working in a private company in Bangalore, India. I have a question regarding "Health Insurance". My company has an agreement with TTK Health Insurance company, and they have given us TTK cards, we can use these cards in select hospitals, and I need not pay the hospital bill, I just need to swipe my card. Is this leagal for me? Is this halal? Please reply. Regards! 2466 views Q. Asalaam u alikum. I am a medical doctor working in reproductive health. I plan to write an article on family planning in the legacy of Islam, and need Islamic Ulama's view(esp from Ahnaf Fiqah)about this issue. Could you please provide me enough information with reasons in this connection? 2731 views Q. Is it permissible for a male to have his hair cut by a ghair-mahram female? 1952 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46599 Country: India Title: Job Offer Question: I am getting a job offer in a hotel but the hotel is dealing with alcohol. I was told that I am not going to serve any alcohol. I will be separated from this. So can I opt for that job? Answer ID: 46599 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1164/905/B=9/1434) It is better for Muslims to avoid working in such hotels. If there is some compulsion then you may sell only the halal things instead of alcohol i.e. you should do the job only in severe need. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
